definitions.explanation: To lie down in a relaxed, casual manner, often on the floor, sofa, or grass.
To lie down in a leisurely way while relaxing.

examples.japanese: ソファに{寝転|ねころ}んだ。
examples.english: I lay down on the sofa.

examples.japanese: {畳|たたみ}の{上|うえ}に{寝転|ねころ}んだ。
examples.english: I lay down on the tatami.

examples.japanese: {芝生|しばふ}の{上|うえ}に{寝転|ねころ}んで{空|そら}を{見上|みあ}げた。
examples.english: I lay on the grass and looked up at the sky.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}い{日|ひ}は{部屋|へや}で{寝転|ねころ}んで{本|ほん}を{読|よ}むのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: On hot days, I like lying down in my room reading books.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}のベンチに{寝転|ねころ}んで、{木|き}の{葉|は}の{間|あいだ}から{見|み}える{青|あお}い{空|そら}をぼんやり{眺|なが}めていた。
examples.english: I was lying on a park bench, gazing absently at the blue sky visible through the leaves.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}がごろんと{寝転|ねころ}んだ。
{犬|いぬ}が{芝生|しばふ}の{上|うえ}で{寝転|ねころ}んでいる。
examples.english: The dog is rolling around on the grass.

examples.japanese: {布団|ふとん}の{上|うえ}で{子供|こども}たちが{寝転|ねころ}んで{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The children are rolling around playing on the futon.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんがベッドの{上|うえ}で{楽|たの}しそうに{寝転|ねころ}んでいた。
examples.english: The baby was happily rolling over on the bed.

examples.japanese: {暖|あたた}かい{日差|ひざ}しの{中|なか}で、{子犬|こいぬ}たちが{砂|すな}の{上|うえ}をごろごろ{寝転|ねころ}んで{楽|たの}しそうに{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: In the warm sunshine, the puppies were rolling around happily on the sand, playing together.

notes:
{寝転|ねころ}ぶ is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to lie down casually.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {寝|ね}る (to sleep/lie down) + {転|ころ}ぶ (to roll/tumble) → to roll into a lying position

ASPECT (ている):
{寝転|ねころ}んでいる indicates a state of lying down.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ソファに{寝転|ねころ}ぶ (lie on the sofa)
- {畳|たたみ}に{寝転|ねころ}ぶ (lie on the tatami)
- {芝生|しばふ}に{寝転|ねころ}ぶ (lie on the grass)
- {寝転|ねころ}んで{本|ほん}を{読|よ}む (read while lying down)

VARIANT:
- {寝転|ねころ}がる: same meaning, alternative form

NUANCE:
Casual, relaxed lying down—not the formal act of going to bed ({寝|ね}る). Implies a leisurely, comfortable position.

[Register: Casual to Neutral]
